translation:
The cold-strike manuals call it chronic chill (guleng); chronic (痼) indeed is also one class. True origin, meeting the scene, both interior and exterior causation; abdominal pain with cold limbs and quivering lips.
Lower back and legs ache heavily, sitting like on ice; spontaneous sweating destroying yang flows the cold essence. Also called yang collapse with yin wilting (萎); the draining yang returning to source, moxibustion is the efficacious one.
The word 厥 (jue/cold-reversal) in the formularies is likewise very many; carefully examine the principle, not a hair's breadth wrong. Jue means exhaustion, ni (逆) means cold; look at inspection, auscultation-ol-faction, interrogation and palpation, see how it is.
Yang-reversal first heat then reversal; the Classics say as heat is deep so is reversal deep. Yin-reversal first reversal then heat; the Classics say direct-attack entering the yin channels.
Others such as cold reversal with cold of the limbs, are always changing lines (爻), not to be relied on. Fuzi Lizhong Tang (Aconite Regulate-the-Centre Decoction) uses it after deliberation; again moxa Guanyuan and Qihai, divine.
Four-reversal (sini) is the four limbs being cold; one must know deep and shallow and use the knife-and-gold (acupping/dosing) accordingly. When the pathogen is at the exterior, the hands and feet are hot; at half exterior half interior it is slightly warm.
Cold reversal of the four limbs, the pathogen entering the interior; transmission through the channels, step by step, is very clear. From heat to warmth, from warmth to cold — Sini Tang (Four-Reversal Decoction) and powders quickly search for them.
translator_notes: 痼冷=chronic chill; 四逆=sini (four-reversal) — cold of all four limbs.
附子理中湯=Fuzi Lizhong Tang; 四逆湯=Sini Tang.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Delirious speech (zhanyu) is confused, chaotic speech; throwing of voice, thrown and rushing, is an improper sound. When the pathogen qi is strong then there is delirium; when the essence qi rushes then there is throwing of voice.
Mild, then muttering within sleep; severe, then even after waking there are eerie words. Speaking to oneself two or three words toward the wall — the lightness or severity of heat-pathogen is already distinguished.
translator_notes: 譫語=delirious speech (zhanyu); 擲聲=throwing sound, raving/ejaculatory utterance.
unresolved: "擲聲" rendered literally as "throwing voice"; parallel to 譫語 raving.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The defensive (wei) qi travels the yang by day, like waking; yang excessive, yin deficient, it governs sleeplessness. The defensive qi travels the yin by night, like sleeping; yin excessive, yang failing, the eyes freely close in sleep.
What is called not-sleeping is not sleeping at night; what is called much-sleeping is also sleeping by day. When cold damage brings this it is a reversed sign; Zaozi (Suanzaoren, Sour Jujube Seed) with Shengdi (Rehmannia) bring and decoct them.
translator_notes: 棗仁=Suanzaoren (Ziziphi Spinosae Semen); 生地=Shengdihuang (fresh Rehmannia).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
